description: This Java class 'UpDownImage' renders visual representations of engine report data, including signal waveforms, revolution logs, and time axes, for a UI component in an engine diagnostics or analysis application.

classes.name: UpDownImage
classes.description: A Swing JPanel subclass that visualizes engine signal data, revolution logs, and timing information for a specific engine report channel.

methods.name: UpDownImage
methods.description: Constructor initializing with engine report and channel name, setting up mouse listeners and tooltips.

methods.name: setSignalBody
methods.description: Sets the color used for the signal body in the visualization.

methods.name: setSignalBorder
methods.description: Sets the color used for the signal border in the visualization.

methods.name: setToolTip
methods.description: Updates the tooltip text with channel and pin information.

methods.name: setZoomProvider
methods.description: Placeholder for setting zoom functionality (empty implementation).

methods.name: setWaveReport
methods.description: Updates the engine report data and triggers repaint.

methods.name: propagateDwellIntoSensor
methods.description: Stores the duration of the last signal pulse into a sensor object.

methods.name: paint
methods.description: Custom rendering of signal waveforms, scale lines, and revolution markers.

methods.name: drawStartOfRevolution
methods.description: Draws vertical lines indicating revolution start points based on revolution log.

methods.name: isShowTdcLabel
methods.description: Determines whether to display TDC labels; defaults to false.

methods.name: paintScaleLines
methods.description: Draws vertical scale lines at millisecond intervals, if appropriate.

methods.name: paintUpDown
methods.description: Draws individual signal pulses with timing and angle annotations.

methods.name: setPhysicalPin
methods.description: Sets the physical pin label and updates tooltip.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
